name: Gaussian Grouping
definition: A method enhancing 3DGS by incorporating identity encodings for 3D objects, enabling grouping based on identity, object removal, inpainting, and recomposition.
summary: Gaussian Grouping enhances 3D Gaussian Splatting by assigning object IDs to splats, enabling precise object-level editing like removal and inpainting with fewer artifacts than sibling methods.
